assessment: Mitochondrial glutathione is an important line of defence against free radical production. The ATP binding cassette (ABC) transporter Atm3 exports oxidized glutathione out of the mitochondria to help maintain a suitable reducing environment. In this study, the authors have biochemically characterized Atm3 and determined four cryo-EM structures exhibiting three different conformational states, revealing new insights into the transport mechanism. This well-executed study will be of broad interest to the membrane biology and transport communities.
